notes: Qualified volunteers (18+, after a training session) take shelter dogs on regular walks and on field trips to local dog parks or other approved places; sign up via the volunteer page.

Available anytime the shelter is open: register online, stop by to pick an adventure buddy, then walk, grab a pup cup, explore a park or hang out together (sleepovers possible) and fill out a doggie report card; groups schedule ahead.

Free 'Check Me Out' afternoons (last listed April 12, 2026, 1-4pm): fill out a liability form, get paired with an adoptable dog and take it out for a walk, pup cup or time at home; no later dates posted yet.

notes: Volunteer page says the shelter offers a doggie day out program; contact the shelter for details (dog handlers must be 18+).
Bring your ID to the shelter and ask to take a dog on a field trip for a few hours; dogs go out weekdays 12-3:30pm and must be back by 4pm for dinner.

program: Dog walking shifts and Hendo Hounds Walking Club
notes: Approved volunteers sign up for daily dog-walking shifts (9-11am or 3-5pm) after the online volunteer application; the Hendo Hounds Walking Club also walks shelter dogs on Saturdays 10am-4pm.

offers: On-site dog walking, cat cuddling, reading to animals
notes: Volunteer page welcomes people of all ages to stop by during open hours to walk dogs, cuddle cats or read to the animals; the site was last updated years ago, so call ahead.

program: Volunteer dog walking and Rescue Reads
offers: On-site dog walking, playtime, cat socializing, reading to animals
notes: Volunteers of all ages (under 18 with an adult) can walk dogs, play with them and socialize cats at the shelter; Rescue Reads evenings let kids read to shelter animals (dates coming soon).

offers: Day trip; monthly Check Meowt Book Club with adoptable cats
notes: Adults 18+ with photo ID and a working cell phone sign a waiver, then take a dog out for the day: pick up 2-4 pm Tue-Fri at the Malcomb campus (1600 Old Frankfort Pike, return by 5 pm) or at the Everyday Adoption Center in PetSmart (2-4 pm Mon-Fri, return by 5 pm; 11 am-1 pm Sat-Sun, return by 2 pm). No dog parks or personal pets; may close in hot or bad weather, so call 859-233-0044 ext. 223 first.
Trained volunteers and corporate volunteer teams pick up a dog at Sam Swope Pet TLC (241 Steedly Dr) Tuesday-Saturday between 8:30 and 11 a.m. and return it by 4 p.m.; one dog per outing.
Adults 18+ attend an orientation, then can take a shelter dog out for the day to a park, dog-friendly business or home.

offers: Field trips (a few hours), optional approved overnighters
notes: Contact ACS to get matched with an eligible dog, take it for a walk, a park or trail, a dog-friendly store or a Starbucks pup cup for a few hours, then bring it back at the agreed time; leash always, no off-leash dog parks; overnighters must be approved.
Pick a dog at the shelter the morning of your outing; an adult 18+ must supervise, stay within Calloway County, no dog parks, and return the dog by closing time. Harness and leash provided.
Approved volunteers who complete a volunteer application are paired with a shelter dog for a day out (park, backyard, drive, walk) and share the outing on social media.

Winter 2025 newsletter describes Doggy Day Out: pick a dog you like and take it on a date (dog park, pup cup, meet your family) between 10:30am and 3:15pm; call the shelter for details, as it isn't on the main site.
